1237.synopsis:
In the capital city of Elden, within the lawless kingdom of Sunland, there exists an underground space sealed by the massive bones of a dragon known as Legasios No In. These bones act as a ‘lid,’ trapping creatures from other dimensions, commonly referred to as ‘Freaks.’ 
A group daringly ventures into this perilous underground realm in search of treasure. They are Clan ZOO, led by the beautiful yet unreliable Mariarose, who aims to acquire treasures in perfect (or perhaps not-so-perfect?) form—although things don’t always go as planned! 
In the face of any battle, destiny, or betrayal, it is their presence that gives them the strength to keep living. 
This is the ultimate tale of Maria, the gentle ‘invader (cracker),’ and their companions.
associated_names: A Brave Heart of Red Rose

4821.synopsis: Obino Kazuya was doing multiple jobs so he could save up 30 million by the age of 29 and retire. After getting kidnapped by his internet poker friend, who turns out to be a Maou, he became her pet/caretaker.
associated_names: I, with house work and cooking, take away the backbone of the Demon lord! ~The beginning of the peerless house-husband in another world~
Ore wa Ryouri to Kaji de Maou wo Honenuki ni Suru
俺は料理と家事で魔王を骨抜きにする～異世界から始まる主夫無双～

7125.synopsis: A young priestess has formed her first adventuring party, but almost immediately they find themselves in distress. It’s the Goblin Slayer who comes to their rescue – a man who’s dedicated his life to the extermination of all goblins, by any means necessary. And when rumors of his feats begin to circulate, there’s no telling who might come calling next.

7893.synopsis: Due to a false charge, Felicia Swallows who was admired by the young ladies got her engagement with His Highness annulled and was expelled from school. There’s nothing but misunderstandings all around her, but the person herself only wants a rose-coloured commoner’s life. It’s a story about characters from “Nation’s Saviour Lady Rose”, an otome game from her previous life.
associated_names: Lady Rose Just Wants to Be a Commoner
Lady Rose wa Heimin ni Naritai
レディローズは平民になりたい

10965.synopsis:
Luo Qiu became the boss of a ‘club’ by chance. 
It was a weird club that sold strange items and with a servant girl that had 300 years of working experience. Countless people with dreams, hopes and ambitions came to the club to exchange anything precious they own for what they want. They would offer their lifespan, items, and even their soul. Every successful trade would increase Luo Qiu’s lifespan by a little. 
“Tribute successful, your lifespan has increased by 99 years.” 
As thus, Luo Qiu began his endless life as the club’s boss.

11733.synopsis:
Year 2140, the world is full of superpowers.
Those who can create fire.
Those who can create water.
Those who use supernatural power.
Those who use sorcery.
And the only one without powers
Originally, he should be weak.
But somehow, he is — considerably strong.

16597.synopsis:
The main protagonist Chen He often meets crazy people in his life, and all these people have very deep prejudices against him. They often do weird things.
Once, Chen He polished off a bunch of hired killers (who seemed to be after him?), and eventually found the mastermind.
Chen He: You and I are complete strangers, so why are you doing this to me?
Mastermind: You’re gonna kill me after ten years! Of course I’ve got to make a preemptive strike.
Chen He: …
Chen He: Sir, we have had no bad blood between us, and I have not done anything to offend you. Why are you being so threatening?
Taoist priest: Hmph! In the future, you’ll be offending me to no end. Haven’t you been looking down on me all your life?
Chen He: …but I still have my entire life ahead of me!
Antagonist A: Chen He! Because of your master, I was rejected by XX Sect, and so I was forced to become a demonic cultivator!
Chen He: Who…who are you?
Antagonist B: My future lover’s meridians and good looks were ruined by you, and I’m definitely not gonna let you do it this time!
Chen He could not help but think: There is definitely something wrong with my life!

17365.synopsis:
I, Oohira Tooru, who is reincarnated into the world of otome game for beginners, “Shirayuri no Kimi to…”, am planning to live as minute as possible behind my outstanding sister.
However, I, who realize that we’ll go into destruction end if things continue this way, have to clean up after the mess that my sister keeps making.
Several years have gone in this fashion… I’m only cleaning up, but somehow, I’ve raised entirely different flags from the capturable guys, leaving me bewildered.
Moreover, something weird is going on with the game’s heroine…?
associated_names: The Villainess Noble Girl’s Younger Brother

18645.synopsis:
He, Yuuyami Riku, suffered from familial ab*se.
No, it was not from his parents.
He was on the receiving end of his little sister’s violent tendencies.
One day, he stood up against such a sister. For the first time, he told her off. And yet, on that night, his enraged sister stabbed him to death as he was fast asleep.
However, Riku was reborn, and now was a baby.
Jubilous about his new life, he almost didn’t notice a huge problem…
associated_names: 転生して前世の俺の妹になりました

19413.synopsis:
GunGun, as a national treasure(panda), was stolen by thieves and skinned. Once he woke up, he had a healthy body and lots of bamboo leaves. But monsters with glowing eyes surrounded him, most importantly they were floating, have greenish blue faces, fangs, and have no little legs?!
(⊙o⊙) Oh, the two-legged monster is here again, huh, is this bowl of food for him? These tender leaves are delicious, they should be hidden in the deepest part of the den.
There was an extra panda cub in the Interstellar Admiral’s embrace which he brought everywhere he goes. The place where a gun was once placed turned into a place for holding a basket full of leaves.
One day, GunGun became a beautiful boy.
Pouting face GunGun: Big monster I’m hungry. Huh? Where’s my fur!
The admiral’s face flushed crimson red being overwhelmed by its cuteness: “!!!!!” My darling!

21205.synopsis:
Li Yi once lived the dream of every pro gamer. He was at the top of his game with the best equipment, the highest stats, and everything a gamer could ever hope for. However, he soon realized that none of his ill-gotten gains for his to keep when he was branded Public Enemy Number One and killed in the biggest battle of the ages.
Now, he has the chance to turn back the clock and return to a time before his first mistake put him on the path of no return. This time, Li Yi will make different choices. With that, comes many interesting encounters — like saving a woman in distress then making love to her seven times in a row while her child slept in the next room. However, will he get back to what truly matters?
One thing is for sure, with the memories retained from his past, he will become King of this game.

23509.synopsis:
Necromancer girl Nene and her best friend Rose were betrayed by the heroes during war with the demon. They were used as decoy so the heroes could escape. Caught in a dilemma, Rose protect Nene from demon and burned into nothing.
In despair, Nene decided to use necromancer’s forbidden magic to return to two years ago. To get revenge on the hero’s party who betray her, and above all, to save her best friend.
Nene who successfully return to two years ago immediately left the hero’s party and decided to live the life of “second playtrough”.
With undead girl which Nene resurrected, Fran, and Rose who just met Nene for the first time in this world, the curtain of the girls’ strongest second playtrough is open!

25301.synopsis:
Two years ago, Xu Xuan was the No.1 genius of the Xu Family and was rather famous among the young generation in Cloud City. His mother died of illness when he was a baby and he wanted to be father’s pride. That was why he challenged the person with the much higher cultivation in the martial arts competition.
Unfortunately, Xu Xuan lost. And his dantian was broken by vicious enemy. But he didn‘t reconciled at all. For the past two years, he had but he had persisted in cultivating every morning in the hope that there would be a miracle. However, there is not until he met the superior of Mysterious God Realm who was escaping. After a fierce struggle, Xu Xuan swallowed unique treasure Nine-Swallowing Divine Jade and obtained a low-grade Heaven rank cultivation technique Five Spiritual Arts.
Xu Xuan would never forget the scenes of how the marriage was annulled yesterday, nor the disdainful gazes of others, let alone their smiles after his dantian had been broken. What legendary road will this ordinary boy from the wilderness embark on？

26325.synopsis:
She is the daughter of the Cang Yue Kingdom’s head general – Wu Ruo Jun, with extraordinary martial talents, yet was unfortunate to be befallen with the extermination of her clan. Although disguised as a man, and taking on an alias identity as Shang Jun, and living together with her younger sister while depending on each other, and on the way hiding the urge to seek revenge. She meets Mu Rong Shu Qing, establishes the Misty Hills Estate, and have been taking a stand in resisting Cang Yue.
He is the mysterious prince of Hai Yu – Qin Xiu Zhi, gentle as jade, deeply infatuated in love. Him who have been in exile for a long time had fallen in love with Shang Jun at first sight, but has suffered because of Shang Jun’s male identity, unable to confess, can only stay besides her the whole way, never leaving and never abandoning.
He is the third young master of Cang Yue’s wealthy merchant – Xiao Zong Qing, with a sunny personality, but also overbearingly unreasonable. He had met Shang Jun in a thieve’s den, and under a rainstorm in the raging waves of the sea had sprouted feelings for Shang Jun. For Shang Jun he willingly gives up everything, his love seeping deep into his bone marrows.

30165.synopsis:
Marriage with the villainous ‘Ice Emperor’—despite his harsh words, the voice of his heart is super sweet!?
The Princess of the Southern Kingdom, Tistye, who can read people’s heart, is married to Gaizel, the King of the Northern Kingdom, which is renowned for its outrageous cruelty.
Contrary to his relentless cold words, she can hear the voice of his heart, which is surprisingly mellow—his gap almost causes her to die of embarrassment!
associated_names: Heika, Kokoro no Koe ga Dadamore desu!
Your Majesty, the voice of your heart is leaking!
陛下、心の声がだだ漏れです！

34261.synopsis:
Upon the vast land of the twelve dynasties, eight immortal sects stood, lofty and firm.
Under the guidance of the eldest apprentice Bai Li Shu, the young disciples of Jiu Xuan Sect step onto the Black-plumed Light Vessel, and from there, the era’s repeating secrets began to unfold.
The Savage Era’s passing, the era of Chaos’ ancient kings, and the Ten Thousand Immortals Era’s lapse……
The archaic war once again repeated itself in a new era, and the people holding blades and swords walk onto history’s battlefield behind the scenes.

34517.synopsis:
I have five older sisters. One is a saint who gathers faith, one is a female knight of Ikkitousen, one is a sage seeking truth, one is a wizard who shakes people’s souls, and one is a great merchant who moves the country. Their wisdom and good looks were loved by everyone, but their true nature, which only I could see, was the worst. As an incompetent younger brother, I’ve been receiving abusive words from my sisters every day. But one day, I finally reached the limit of my patience.
“Anyway, I’ll leave this house. I’ve already decided.”
Thus, I left the house and became an adventurer in a remote city. In this way as I started my new life, I started noticing. Huh? Am I by any chance, ultra-competent …! ? Evaluated for my ability, I continue to succeed rapidly.
associated_names: Ie de Munou to Iware Tsuzuketa Ore desu ga, Sekai-teki ni wa Chou Yuunou datta you desu
Worthless at Home, Whiz to the World (LN)
家で無能と言われ続けた俺ですが、世界的には超有能だったようです

36565.synopsis:
Xu Sheng of Class Seven never wore school uniforms. He was the wildest person in Lin Jiang Sixth High School’s history of tyrants. He scored an average of 30 points in each subject and had so many disciplinary notices that they were meaningless. Every few days, he would be subjected to present a disciplinary review in front of the entire school.
The sun blazed in the sky and the youth’s voice was loud for everyone to hear. “Sorry, I still dare next time.”
And the so-called Exam God, number one in the grade, Shao Zhan, was cold and unapproachable. 
Their paths would never have crossed if they didn’t switch bodies due to an accident.
associated_names: This Question is Beyond the Scope
This Question is Difficult to Answer
แอบรักคู่ปรับสลับร่าง

36821.synopsis:
As the last demon cultivator of the 21st century, Yan Ziye was reborn into a future male beastman who committed su*cide after a failed lightning tribulation.
What? As the young master of a large family, he actually committed su*cide because his confession was denied? Is it too weak? What? You’re saying this is just pure male and female beastmen? No half beastmen? Since half beastmen were more fertile than females, did half beastmen become legends? Yan Ziye silently looked in the mirror. The upper body is a human and the lower body is the snake.
In order not to allow himself to become a legend, he felt that he would still train hard and change himself as soon as possible. It is just his plan couldn’t keep up with the changes, and Yan Ziye wasn’t finished with his body yet, so he was swallowed up by the demon who had been waiting for him.

37333.synopsis:
I am Daisy von Preslaria. Even though I was born in a viscount family that produces excellent magicians, I was the only one in my family that was granted the failure job, Alchemist.
Since this has happened, let’s try studying hard and become independent as a worthy alchemist!
The five-year-old girl resolved and began to make potions by trial and error. Thanks to her Appraisal skill that she secretly possessed, let alone misfortune, the finished product was of high-quality never seen anywhere!
She cultivated medicinal herbs, indulged herself in research, went harvesting, and opened a store.
This is a story of an alchemist living carefreely, sometimes fervently, while being helped by various people (by non-humans too).
associated_names: Outo no Hazure no Renkinjutsushi: Hazure Shokukyou Datta node, Nonbiri Omise Keiei Shimasu
The Alchemist on the Outskirts of King's Landing
The Tale of a Little Alchemist Blessed by the Spirits (LN)
王都の外れの錬金術師 ～ハズレ職業だったので、のんびりお店経営します～

40149.synopsis:
Luo Tang in Ancheng No.1 Middle School is sunny and white, and full of youthfulness, but he is also the school overlord with a cold personality and considerable fighting power.
In order to take Luo Tang down a notch, bullies from other schools gave him the nickname Tangtang.
This name succeeded in becoming a minefield for Luo Tang.
But according to a classmate, she heard with her own ears a girl who was not afraid of death and called Luo Tang, Tangtang, and instead of exploding, Luo Tang ran up to her, tail wagging.
Classmate A: Wagging his tail? Do you think Luo Tang is a puppy?
Classmate B: He’s a puppy, a soft dog among giant dogs, like…golden retriever!
Wei Ruxia OS: He isn’t a golden retriever, he’s a little wolf, super fierce!
Note: The ‘tang’ in Luo Tang and the Chinese for sweets/sugar sounds the same.

42197.synopsis:
The person he’s consulting for love advice at his part-time job is actually his crush…!?
Rena Saito, the most beautiful girl in school, and Minato Tanaka became friends through their shared love of reading. They were supposed to be just friends, but the distance between them started to shrink little by little!
One day, Minato, who’s awkward when it comes to love, seeks advice from a senpai at his part-time job. However, for some reason, her face turns bright red…?
“…Don’t worry about it. Keep going, Tanaka-san.”
(I can’t believe she cares about me this much… Ugh, seriously!)
Without realizing that the person he’s consulting for love advice is actually his crush in disguise, he spills all the details about his growing feelings—making her blush! Thus begins an unintentional love comedy!!
associated_names: I've been hitting on the most beautiful girl in school without even knowing it - when I tell my part-time advisor about my crush, she starts to get embarrassed for some reason...
Ore wa Shiranai Uchi ni Gakkou Ichi no Bishoujo wo Kudoiteita Rashii ~ Baito-saki no Soudan Aite ni Ore no Omoibito no Hanashi wo Suru to Kanojo wa Naze ka Terehajimeru ~
俺は知らないうちに学校一の美少女を口説いていたらしい〜バイト先の相談相手に俺の想い人の話をすると彼女はなぜか照れ始める〜

42453.synopsis:
Horus, the fifth prince of the Magref Empire, is considered useless because he can only use the magic of the sand attribute to manipulate the sand, and is banished from the empire.
Thrown into the scorching desert, Horus demonstrates his sand magic and builds a huge sand castle.
Realizing that what seemed to be hell for others was heaven for him, he decided to live here leisurely.
However, through the battle with the demons, friends of various races gather and gradually form a “kingdom” with Horus as the king.
associated_names: Suna Mahou de Suna no Oukoku wo Tsukurou: Sabaku ni Tsuihou Sareta kara Ganbatte Sokoku Ijou no Kokka wo Tatete mita
砂魔法で砂の王国を作ろう～砂漠に追放されたから頑張って祖国以上の国家を建ててみた～

42965.synopsis: Yuto has been an adventurer for 10 years.  10. Long. Years.  He put in the work, the effort, the sweat, and blood, but Yuto is different.  He is the only adventurer to never have leveled up once or hasn’t  acquired any skills.  Yuto finds himself facing a monster way out of his league, gets crushed, and wakes up.  It was from that day when his life begins to change.
associated_names: Ikikaetta Boukensha no Quest Koryaku Seikatsu: Jibun Dake ga Moraeru Skill Point de Hoka no Dare yori Tsuyoku naru
生き返った冒険者のクエスト攻略生活 自分だけがもらえるスキルポイントで他の誰より強くなる

44245.synopsis:
The 13th generation disciple of the Great Mount Hua Sect. One of the Three Great Swordsmen. The Plum Blossom Sword Saint, Chung Myung.
After slicing the head of the peerless Heavenly Demon, who threw the world into chaos, he slept an eternal sleep on the peak of the Hundred Thousand Great Mountains. Jumping over a hundred years, he comes back in the body of a child.
But… what? Mount Hua declined? What the hell are you talking about!?
It’s only natural to want to live if you’re going broke.
“Decline? Even though I’m here? Who would dare!”
Plum blossoms eventually fall.
But when the cold winter passes and spring comes, plum blossoms shall bloom again.
“But I’m gonna die first before Mount Hua gets revived! If you’re gonna go bust, might as well do it right, you bastards!”
The beginning of the Plum Blossom Sword Saint, Chung Myung’s solitary struggle to save the thoroughly declining Mount Hua Sect.
associated_names: Return of the Blossoming Blade (Official Webtoon)
Return of the Mount Hua Sect

45269.synopsis:
Gu Mian transmigrated as the female partner of the popular novel “I’m So Popular”. The original owner disliked the fact that the male lead came from a bad background and dumped him three times which resulted in a tragic end of their relationship.
Gu Mian was fearless even when she was controlled by the plot.
She only waited for the original plot to end so that she would retreat and hide her merit and fame.
But!
Gu Mian was stunned.
Why couldn’t she even break up for the first time?
　　-
The male lead said indifferently, “I can’t be your boyfriend anymore.”
Gu Mian breathed a sigh of relief, did he finally agree to break up?
The male lead’s thin lips twitched lightly, “So Mian Mian, let’s get married.”

47317.synopsis:
Xiang Wanwan is a little cowardly and soft-tempered. 
However, it doesn’t matter; although she has a timid personality, she has money! 
She felt like supporting Lu Ziqian was the most extraordinary thing she had done in her life; it took her all the courage she had mustered to do it. 
Lu Ziqian found it strange…
 Where did this little girl standing in front of him, with a height only at his chest level, get the courage to say that she wanted to take care of a CEO?

49621.synopsis:
Echinecia Roaz was an ordinary Countess.
Until she suffered the cruel fate of being manipulated by a magical sword and killing all her loved ones.
[This miracle won’t happen twice. So, do your best and be happy.]
She turned her time back to change her own fate.
However, the root cause of the problem has not disappeared, and she is still not free from the past.
“I never talked to the Commander, how did you know me? I…… Did I offend you in some way?”
“There was no such thing. It was just that you stood out from the crowd and caught my eye.”
“Stood out? Is it because of my hair?”
“…… No, it was my personal interest.”
A man who has answers to her past and a woman who wants to erase that same past.
Will she be able to overcome her fate and become happy?
associated_names: The Flower Who Bears The Sword

50645.synopsis:
I possessed the ex-wife of my favorite character.
The body that would die even before the original story began due to an infectious disease.
‘Oh, what else should I do? If I’m going to die anyway, I have to be a fangirl of my favorite character as much as I want!’
However, I survived with the awakening of a power that wasn’t in the original story.
What was worse, in the meantime, I had hit on my in-laws so well, though?
“You are probably the only one who puts your life in Akid’s pictures more than the commissioned.”
Wouldn’t Personality Breaker 1 who was full of chills, my father-in-law, help me with my fangirling?
“Then haven’t I told you to not look cute? There are many criminals in the world who aim for cute kids like you.”
My mother-in-law that was once called the ‘Haint’s Mad Dog’ the Personality Breaker 2 overprotect me severely, let alone being cold.
And my innocent husband started to flirt with me all the time. 
“Lonne’s hair looks like cotton candy.”
“My hair surely is a bit messy.”
“Not at all. I’m just saying that I want to keep touching it all the time because it’s so soft.”
I thought my existence was too dangerous for him.
Yet—
“Lonne, can you guess who’s more dangerous now?”
It turned out that the dangerous one wasn’t me, but him, right?

50901.synopsis:
“Isn’t, isn’t that bastard crazy?”
Cahill was standing in front of the men with his excited manhood dangling.
Holly’s face flushed because it was obvious why he was mad all the way to the top of his head at the assassins.
“That Ice God.”
Holly meets the Ice God Cahill while trying to avoid debtors.
Cahill, who has just opened his eyes up to s*x, stretches out a hand of seduction to the vigilant Holly…….
Accompanying the man who was suspicious from head to toe.
Is it really okay as it is?

52181.synopsis:
Possessing a maid was not enough, but even a second possession as a princess!
At first, I possessed the evil maid ‘Lari’, destined to die at the hands of the male lead ‘Thierry’. In order to avoid my death, I took great care of the male lead and thought that I had made him a pure child. Until one day, without knowing why, I died.
***
“The princess woke up!”
But when I opened my eyes, 7 years have passed.
I’m even a princess?
“This is my last offer. I will treasure the princess.”
The bigger problem was that Thierry, who had grown up in the meantime, came in and offered to take me to his own country.
No matter what misunderstanding there was, I didn’t want to reveal to Thierry that I was “Lari.” But what’s wrong with him?
***
“…Are you afraid of me?”
I stared at him with a blank expression on my face.
The red eyes facing me shook, and he lowered them as if avoiding my gaze.
“I won’t do anything you don’t like. If there’s anything you want, I’ll do it.”
He continued his words nervously as if he was wary of me, and I looked at him, stunned even more. 
“Then…can you look at me?”

52437.synopsis:
When student teacher Hirose returns to his alma mater for a few weeks, he notices strange events seem to be revolving around a student, Kaname Takasato. As Hirose soon learns, Takasato was said to have been “spirited away” and then mysteriously reappearing one year later without any memories of where he had been or what had happened to him.
While some students are fascinated with Takasato, others have taken to avoiding him, particularly as rumours emerge that bad things tend to happen to anyone who tries to upset Takasato. As Hirose tries to learn more about Takasato, he soon witnesses firsthand the strange occurrences surrounding Takasato as the consequences grow ever more severe and horrifying.
The author later worked certain events from this novel into the Twelve Kingdoms series. Chronologically this novel takes place after the fourth Twelve Kingdoms book, Skies of Dawn (風の万里 黎明の空; Kaze no Banri, Reimei no Sora) and some events are covered in book six (黄昏の岸 暁の天; Tasogare no Kishi, Akatsuki no Sora).
associated_names: 魔性の子 十二国記 0

54997.synopsis:
I am Marianna of the Duke of La-Tour . I was reincarnated as a Villainess.
It seems that I was reincarnated into the world of an Otome Game that I played in my previous life, but even if I use my knowledge, my death flags may or may not be broken…….
So I’m going to live my life seriously and sincerely as a Young Noble Lady.
associated_names: Why I was a villainous daughter
わたくしが悪役令嬢だった理由

55509.synopsis:
As a Spirit Messenger, I was reincarnated in a monster-infested earth. 
But here, there is no such thing as a spirit. 
“Lucky.” 
Monsters? Dungeon? Those sorts of things are for hunters to solve, right? As a non-awakened person, I just had to enjoy the normal life I had dreamed of. 
But by chance- which wasn’t really by chance- I touched an unidentified egg from dungeon.  
「 Congratulations! ‘Yu Ina’ has awakened! 」 
“……What?”
I could hear my soothing life moving away. 
[Hahaha! She’s a contractor!] [My contractor!] 
“Who’s your contractor?” 
It was already sad to be a spirit messenger again, but the spirits only caused accidents.  That was not even the end of the matter. 
“If you want to get out, get out.”
I’m ranked No. 1 in Korea, which somehow ends up with me being treated as a part-time nanny. 
“Now that I see you, you’re a special person.”
To the head of the Hunter Association, who drags luxury sedans around and puts me in trouble. 
“I want to get closer to you. As a person to person.”
Even the guild leader of the big guild that we encounter often! 
“Everyone, get lost.”
Give me back my peaceful life!

56789.synopsis:
Allen opened the book.
And there it was.
The fact he wanted to ignore. No, the fact he actually was aware of.
[…Reader Kim Woojin, 21.
Possessed the extra character, ‘Julius Reinhart’, of the novel “The Feast of the Returned Demon King”…]
Julius Reinhart.
My brother’s body was stolen by a possessor.
That day, my brother died.

57557.synopsis:
I, Hinata Amamiya, have a childhood friend.
Her name is Suzuka Ichinose, and even though I’ve known her for over a decade, I can surely say she’s cute and bright, and she’s always surrounded by friends, guys and girls alike.
She and I have been together since we were little children, and our relationship hasn’t changed even after we became high schoolers. I took her for granted, thinking she’d always stand by my side. That’s what I believed in.
But I was the only one who did…
associated_names: Daijina Mono wa Shitsu Kushite Wakaru
大事なものは失くしてわかる。

58837.synopsis:
Takato Yanagi had a crush on Rinka Kujou and posted his one-sided love for her on his back account.
But one day.
He said, “Hey, what’s that?　This back-account belongs to Yanagi-kun, right? Because the person he write about in places that he have a crush on is definitely me.”
It was discovered that everything was being watched.
Yanagi thought he was going to be creeped out, but…
“Do you like me?”
It didn’t.
Yanagi, who no longer knows what to do, decides to say goodbye to his indecisive past self who couldn’t say “I love you” —
A coming-of-age love story that begins with a fake account.
He gets to know his unrequited love who knows nothing about her, and he falls more and more in love with her.
“I love her so much, I don’t know what to do about it.”
associated_names: Kataomoi shite iru kurasu ichi no bishōjo ni ura aka de ai no messēji o tōkō shi teta no ga bareteta
片思いしているクラス一の美少女に裏アカで愛のメッセージを投稿してたのがバレてた

61653.synopsis: Jiang Ting traveled through various variety shows and reached the top to win the championship.

63445.synopsis:
Lu Yao stumbled upon a pixel art game where players take on the role of a God in it, but it didn’t take him long to realize that this game connects players to the many worlds of different dimensions.

65749.synopsis:
I wanted to live like the protagonist in a parenting novel.
But the reality of a wacky romance world has even patched my family with K-patches.
“I thought I was reborn into a parenting story, but it turned out to be a flop…”
Those darned flop parenting story families.
They’re trying to send me to a 40-year-old single father. As if I, who succeeded with my romance novel knowledge, would fall for that?
“Oh, forget about those flop families! Don’t they know I won’t be pushed around anymore?”
Armed with a secret weapon, I went to the duke who the flop family sees as their enemy.
“Oh heroines of contract marriage novels, lend me your strength!”

“I can’t take my eyes off you.”
The corners of his mouth rose in a smile that had never been drawn before.

66261.synopsis:
A humble man in his thirties, living in modern Japan, after successfully evading the fate of becoming a mage, suddenly dies and gets reborn in an 18th-century look-alike world, where magic exists, into a duke’s daughter.

While pondering the situation, the man, a lover of dolls and plushies and also a person with an interest in all things girlish, the so-called “girl inside,” decided to indulge in his hobbies without worries after becoming a girl and live a carefree life.
His girlfriend from the previous world, too, gets reincarnated, and into the prince, no less!
This pair of close and trusted people were arranged to be married to each other. Due to approaching puberty, both of them, who have changed sexes, must come to terms with the expectations society holds for each of them… maybe.
Without any common knowledge of the world, armed only with the barebones information from a past life, this is the story of a man reborn as a noble lady who is to become a fine (?) queen while inventing various sanitary productions with great care in this 18th-century world on the cusp of the industrial revolution.

In a post-war wizarding world, where the Alliance Party—an organization that once stood for unity between magical beings—has fallen into obscurity, a young wizard named Wentworth emerges with a determination to resurrect its ideals. 
Wentworth’s efforts to revive the Alliance Party are met with skepticism and resistance as old prejudices and grudges run deep within the wizarding community. However, his unwavering determination and ability to inspire hope gradually draw a diverse group of supporters to his cause. With Cedric by his side, Wentworth navigates through political intrigue, magical battles, and personal sacrifices.
Ultimately, Wentworth’s journey is a testament to the enduring power of hope, resilience, and the belief that a united front can overcome even the darkest of odds. The Alliance Party’s revival becomes a symbol of progress, reminding all magical beings that their shared future is worth fighting for.

68565.synopsis:
The first time Shanshan saw it was when the cruise ship had overturned. The monster extended over a dozen enormous tent**les and dragged her to the bottom of the ocean. With its arms wrapped around her, the monster began to have its way with her.
When she got to the deserted island, the same monster voluntarily eagerly sought out rare seafood delicacies and juicy fruits for her. And in exchange, all Shanshan had to do was spread her legs.
However, Shanshan began to notice something eerie. The terrifying tentacle monster was beginning to look more and more like a human. Its upper body had transformed into that of a handsome man, while its lower half retained his thick, long, and muscular tent**les. When the rescue team arrived, she brought “him” into human society.
And thus, they began living a free and unrestrained life from now on…Not!
During a random day.
“What are you doing?!” Shanshan yelled exasperatedly.
The “man” she had brought back had twisted open another man’s head with one of his tent**les, chewing the brain matter with an eerie delight.
“Why did you do that…?” Shanshan weakly knelt on the ground, her head pressed powerlessly against the earth.
“He” tossed the mutated body aside and swarmed to Shanshan’s side with his tent**les, but embraced her with his human arm.
“I love you, Shanshan.”
“Shanshan, I love you more than anyone in this world.”
“Shanshan, you mustn’t like anyone else.”
As he held her, his tent**les made their way below her summer couture dress. Shanshan fell into his arms and let out a moan.
“I don’t like that man.” Shanshan explained weakly, feeling a large, slick object slowly entering her body. Ah…so full…
She had merely glanced at that guy for more than a second.
“I know that, because you love me the most.” He hugged her tightly in his arms, filling her from the inside, as several tent**les wrapped around her body restraining her.
And only me.
He was a powerful deep-sea creature who had traveled across dimensions, to find the one destined for him.

71893.synopsis:

“I’m getting married at the end of the month, so don’t look for me anymore. I’m asking you for the last time.”
There was no emotion in his dry voice.
There was no hatred, just a calm voice delivering a boring piece of news.
***
Heartbroken, Yuris could not love her arranged marriage to Chaint.
But he loved his wife like a steadfast old tree.
No matter how much it hurt, no matter how many times she called her childhood lover’s name in her nightmares, no matter how many times he whispered that he loved her.
That was until the sudden war took everything away.
Her husband came back dead, her parents were gone, and her beloved country was reduced to ashes.
And Yuris died with a deep regret.
That’s what she thought when she opened her eyes. On a peaceful spring day eight years ago.
“Yuris, are you still asleep?”
Kylan had been sweet, but it didn’t matter now.
‘I don’t know why I’m back in the past, but I’m going to stop the war.’
And…….
‘My husband, Chaint, is alive.’

72149.synopsis:
You can arouse me like no other, a true aphrodisiac that elevates me to blissful heights. Yet you also can lead me astray, like a venomous poison slowly dragging me toward the depths of despair.

72661.synopsis:

78549.synopsis:
The spirit of a bloodthirsty gale possesses a maid in the imperial palace. Trusting solely in her dazzling beauty, she becomes entangled in the romance between the emperor and the female lead, a role that often ends in losing one’s life.

80853.synopsis:
Yu Xizhi transmigrated through a novel and became the second senior sister of the sect with a very low presence in this xianxia novel.
According to the plot, the original character would grow twisted with jealousy for her junior sister, the female lead being endlessly favored, and totally blacken. She became a stepping stone for the little junior sister to reach enlightenment; she would be killed with a sword and and up with nothing left of her soul.
In order to survive, Yu Xizhi stayed up all night practicing swordsmanship and striving to level up. In the end, she unexpectedly harbored a surging spiritual energy capable of propelling her to the realm of Grandmaster with a single wave. Looking at her fellow sect members, who were still painstakingly cultivating their foundations, and the sect leader, who hadn’t even reached the Dongxuan stage, she suddenly felt that the story might not be as she had imagined—clearly, this was a high-level player returning to the newbie village!
So what kind of high-risk profession is Second Senior Sister exactly! She’s so powerful, yet she can still be pierced through the heart by the junior sister’s sword?! No, she has to practice more.
Thus, everyone watched as the once-indifferent Second Senior Sister wholeheartedly pursued the Dao.
First, she broke the sword of the senior brother during the sect’s sword selection conference.
In the secret realm trial, she effortlessly outperformed elite disciples of other sects, easily obtaining predestined treasures.
Then, she made a name for herself in the Five Sects and Three Paths Sword Competition, taking the lead overnight and becoming everyone’s goddess.
The rising star Yu Xizhi would never again be pierced through the heart by a single sword, but one thing made her very distressed.
Every time after she showed off her strength and coolness, she turned around to see the true villain, the junior martial uncle who had truly turned evil in the original book, looking at her with a smile on his face, his eyes twinkling mischievously.
Villainous and beautiful with a ruthless heart—Junior Uncle X Pretending to be weak and charming with a strong will- Second Senior Sister

82645.synopsis:

In the era when the strong were respected, even if his family was rich, he couldn’t get rid of the name of a waste.
It coincided with the launch of the Empire’s first holographic online game and gave extremely generous rewards, attracting countless people to participate.
Ran Qi immediately decided to lie down and laughed at the same time. He was ready to indulge in the online game, but who could tell him why this online game was the same as the RPG game where he spent countless RMB??!
Furthermore, his skill trees and warehouse followed.
Ran Qi: “…”

“I told you, you don’t have to do anything. Just focus on getting your ankle healed.”

Although his affection seemed rough, it was pure, and Yeon-ha gradually opened her heart to him, finding herself unknowingly drawn to him.

87765.synopsis:
[Confusing himself with a Movie Character? The Cold-Hearted Actor, Yoon Yiryeong, Who Abandoned his Own Child.]
A child was born from a s*erm donation he made as a joke. And it wasn’t even his s*erm; it came from another man.

“Go take care of the kid.”
“Aunt!”
“I told you to call me Boss! Go take care of the kid. Even if it’s just a show, do it until the public calms down!”
He had never thought of a child as cute, but for some reason, this child kept catching his attention.
“You’re back.”
And Dogwon, who was always busy caring for the child yet still managed to convey warmth to her as well,

I liked that the two of us, flustered, would bustle about because of the baby.

91605.synopsis:
Synopsis:
Wen Zhao transmigrated into a low-magic Xianxia novel, only to discover she’d become the cannon fodder second female lead who bullied the female lead, seduced the male lead, and was generally a green tea b*tch, lotus-flower-like antagonist.

93397.synopsis:
Yan Chuan was frail and sickly, and in order to survive, he participated in an unlimited variety show.
Contestants receive different identity cards, enter horror-themed variety shows to play roles, and earn points to redeem tasks.
Chuan is sick and weak, beautiful, as fragile as glass, pale, and incompatible with horror variety shows.
So when the audience first saw Yan Chuan—
“Cannon fodder, one game and he’s out.”
“Looking at Zhou Zhi, in infinite variety shows, they don’t care about appearances; the boss kills without considering what the contestants look like.”
However, the identity card that Yan Chuan received was—
A money-worshipping lover who plays both sides, a women’s clothing anchor who scams money, a greedy and foolish little thief, and a person overwhelmed by his wife…
Audience Silence: Is this a horror variety show?
In the dungeon [Apartment Building 13] , the contestants enter the apartment building and lie down with NPCs who are indistinguishable from humans or ghosts…
Yan Chuan became the one who gently deceived his wife. “I can’t count the number of people on the pillow; how do you know who is lying next to me?”
When night fell, a gentle and handsome man lay beside him, trying to determine if it was his “husband,” when there was a knock at the door.
“Your husband isn’t home, is he?”
The “husband” lifted a cold, shiny knife. Just when the audience thought Yan Chuan was going to be eliminated, the boss’s knife slashed at the knocker outside, and a fight ensued.
The boss turned back, arguing while fighting: “I’m his husband!”
The audience was shocked: “Why is the boss fighting for the players?”
Yan Chuan shook his head honestly: “I don’t understand either.”
In the dungeon [Shutter Island Prison] , the contestants hide from monsters that emerge at night and must deal with the warden during the day.
Yan Chuan became a little thief dissatisfied with the prison guards and attempted to attack the warden, hoping to gain their protection.
Trembling and pale, he tried to complete his mission and obtained the prison map from the most ruthless warden.
It was obviously very clumsy acting, yet he deceived the guards and the warden so effectively that the audience, who initially thought he would be eliminated, fell silent…
“Catch more, catch more, we love to watch!”
“Which boss is coming to snatch his wife today?”
“Actually, it’s all about your looks, right?”

2. Usually, a South Korean high school senior who dies right before the entrance exam becomes overpowered in another world.
3. Nevertheless, they face all sorts of hardships before actually becoming overpowered.
Han Yoo-an, guilty of reading the 17-volume traditional fantasy novel “The Book of Irkuth” the day before the college entrance exam, ends up being hit by a truck on the way to the exam and dies.
Did the heavens also feel sorry for the death of a student who scored perfectly on the September mock exam, on the very day of the college entrance exam?

Is this finally the start of an overpowered high school student wreaking havoc in another world? That expectation was short-lived.
Not only is it frustrating enough that he doesn’t understand the language, but he was mistakenly dropped into the imperial palace and became the empress’s pet human. On top of that, there are still four centuries left until the protagonist appears.
Others, when transmigrating into novels, live well and comfortably, but it seems he must have committed some grave sin in his past life. There’s no way he’d be cursed with immortality unless he betrayed and sold out his country.
After rolling around and surviving for 400 years, Han Yoo-an, acquiring the title of Great Sage, now simply… just wants to die peacefully.
However, in order to die, he must make sure the descendant of the witch, Yekarina, who left the curse, becomes emperor…
“Who are you? Why are you helping me?”
‘Oh God, have you finally decided to let me die? Thank you!’
Could this really be a birthday gift from God for his 400th birthday?
The descendant of Yekarina, and the protagonist of this novel, has rolled right into his lap.
